_meta.description: Procgen capability catalog — lists valid subtypes, default parameters, and authoring guidance for LLM-authored procgen nodes.

notes: seed must be an integer. Same seed produces identical heightmap.
paint_zone_config maps zone names to paint_material input IDs.
template_profile applies additional profile shaping on top of noise (basin recommended for FPS levels).
imagegen texture nodes are supported as paint_materials — current compiler emits fallback PNGs.
Interior levels use a flat terrain underlay at Z=0. Geometry sits above it.
wall_material and floor_material inputs are required for correct OBJ material names.
Generated OBJ is staged to Objects/Generated/<slug>/ for RC compiler hand-off.
CRYENGINE_TODO: terrain.dat is copied from flat_arena template until Sandbox re-export.
WFC backtrack limit is 50 steps; falls back to arena grid if exhausted.
Geometry is axis-aligned box meshes, UV scale = 1 unit per meter for tiling materials.
Spawn point is placed in the courtyard (castle/fortress) or open centre (arena/warehouse).
